name: sim_gtower_emergence_casimir_invariants
divergence_log: Emergence test: Casimir invariants of SO(3) and SU(3) only become well-defined when ALL generators are simultaneously active. C2 = L1^2+L2^2+L3^2 is an emergent central element; it cannot be constructed from any single generator or proper subset. Tests centrality, eigenvalue structure, GL-non-invariance.

pytorch.reason: load_bearing: torch tensors for L1,L2,L3 generators; compute C2=L1^2+L2^2+L3^2 numerically; verify [C2,Li]=0 for i=1,2,3; compute C2 eigenvalues (should be 2 for l=1 rep); verify C2 is NOT preserved under random GL(3,R) conjugation.

pyg.reason: not used in this Casimir emergence test; geometric topology tools deferred

z3.reason: load_bearing: z3 UNSAT encodes Schur's lemma structural constraint: Casimir eigenvalue = 0 AND representation dimension > 1 cannot both hold (for so(3): eigenvalue l*(l+1), non-trivial means l>0 → eigenvalue ≥ 2); also UNSAT: C2 eigenvalue = 2 AND l = 0 (trivial rep has C2=0, not 2).

sympy.reason: load_bearing: symbolic L1,L2,L3 as 3x3 matrices; symbolic C2 = L1^2+L2^2+L3^2 = 2*I (verified symbolically); [C2, L1] = 0 proven symbolically; C2 is proportional to identity, confirming it is central (Schur).

clifford.reason: load_bearing: pseudoscalar e123 = e1*e2*e3 in Cl(3,0) is central; verify e123*e1 = e1*e123, e123*e2 = e2*e123, e123*e3 = e3*e123; this is the Clifford analog of the Casimir: it requires ALL three grade-1 generators to construct.

e3nn.reason: load_bearing: e3nn irrep D^l has Casimir eigenvalue l*(l+1); extract Wigner-D matrices for l=0,1,2; compute C2 numerically from the generators; verify C2 = l*(l+1)*I for each l; confirms e3nn irreps realize the Casimir structure.

rustworkx.reason: load_bearing: Casimir emergence DAG; SO(3) Casimir node has in-degree=3 (requires L1, L2, L3 all active); SU(3) Casimir node has in-degree=8 (requires all 8 Gell-Mann generators); single generator cannot construct a Casimir alone (in-degree would need to be 1, but Casimir is a sum).

xgi.reason: load_bearing: hyperedge {L1, L2, L3, C2_so3} of size 4; Casimir is a 4-body relationship (three generators and the invariant they collectively define); a pairwise edge {Li, C2} would misrepresent the structure.

casimir_so3_equals_2I.detail: C2 = -(L1^2+L2^2+L3^2) = 2*I in l=1 rep (physics convention); Casimir is proportional to identity (central by Schur's lemma)

casimir_commutes_with_L1.detail: [C2, L1] = 0: Casimir commutes with L1 generator

casimir_commutes_with_L2.detail: [C2, L2] = 0: Casimir commutes with L2 generator

casimir_commutes_with_L3.detail: [C2, L3] = 0: Casimir commutes with L3 generator

casimir_eigenvalues_all_2.detail: C2 eigenvalues all = 2 in l=1 rep; confirms l*(l+1) = 1*2 = 2

partial_casimir_not_central_requires_all.detail: Partial C2 = -(L1^2+L2^2) (missing L3) does NOT commute with L1; centrality REQUIRES all three generators — Casimir is an emergent whole-algebra invariant

sympy_casimir_equals_2I_symbolic.detail: Symbolic C2 = -(L1^2+L2^2+L3^2) = 2*I confirmed by sympy (physics convention; anti-Hermitian generators); Casimir is exactly 2*identity

sympy_casimir_commutes_L1_symbolic.detail: Symbolic [C2,L1]=0: Casimir is central; proven by sympy matrix algebra

sympy_partial_casimir_not_2I.detail: -(L1^2+L2^2) (missing L3) ≠ 2*I AND not central: Casimir REQUIRES all three generators

z3_casimir_l1_nonzero_UNSAT.detail: z3 UNSAT: l=1 Casimir eigenvalue = 2 ≠ 0; non-trivial irrep has non-zero Casimir

z3_casimir_l0_zero_SAT.detail: z3 SAT: l=0 Casimir eigenvalue = 0; trivial rep has zero Casimir

z3_casimir_l2_eq_6_SAT.detail: z3 SAT: l=2 Casimir eigenvalue = 6; l*(l+1) formula verified

z3_casimir_l2_not_2_UNSAT.detail: z3 UNSAT: l=2 Casimir eigenvalue ≠ 2 (would require l=1); eigenvalue formula uniquely determines l

clifford_pseudoscalar_central_e1.detail: [e123, e1] = 0: pseudoscalar commutes with e1; central in Cl(3,0)

clifford_pseudoscalar_central_e2.detail: [e123, e2] = 0: pseudoscalar commutes with e2; central in Cl(3,0)

clifford_pseudoscalar_central_e3.detail: [e123, e3] = 0: pseudoscalar commutes with e3; central in Cl(3,0)

clifford_pseudoscalar_requires_all_three.detail: e123 = e1*e2*e3: pseudoscalar constructed only from ALL three grade-1 generators; emergent central element

e3nn_casimir_eigenvalue_l012.detail: e3nn: Casimir eigenvalue l*(l+1) for l=0,1,2 verified numerically via Wigner-D finite differences (physics convention: -(L1^2+L2^2+L3^2))

neg_single_generator_squared_not_casimir.detail: Negative: -L1^2 alone ≠ 2*I; Casimir REQUIRES all three generators; single-generator term is incomplete

neg_partial_casimir_not_central.detail: Negative: -(L1^2+L2^2) (missing L3) does NOT commute with L1; partial Casimir is not central; all generators required for centrality

neg_random_symmetric_not_casimir.detail: Negative: random symmetric matrix does not commute with so(3) generators; Casimir is not generic

z3_wrong_casimir_formula_UNSAT.detail: z3 UNSAT: l*(l+1) = l for l>0 is impossible; Casimir eigenvalue formula is unique

sympy_L1_not_central_wrt_L2.detail: Negative sympy: [L1,L2] ≠ 0; single generator L1 is not central; only Casimir (sum of squares) is central

boundary_l0_casimir_zero.detail: Boundary l=0: Casimir eigenvalue = 0 (trivial rep); emergence only non-trivial for l>0

boundary_casimir_preserved_under_SO3_con.detail: Boundary: C2 IS preserved under SO(3) conjugation (since C2 = 2*I, any conjugation preserves I); at this boundary GL reduces to SO

boundary_zero_generator_breaks_casimir.detail: Boundary: replacing L3 with zero breaks C2 ≠ 2*I; L3 contributes to the (3,3) diagonal entry

rustworkx_casimir_so3_indegree_3.detail: SO(3) Casimir node has in-degree=3: requires all 3 generators; missing any one breaks centrality

rustworkx_casimir_su3_indegree_8.detail: SU(3) Casimir node has in-degree=8: requires all 8 Gell-Mann generators; emergent from 8-generator shell

rustworkx_generator_nodes_indegree_0.detail: Generator nodes have in-degree=0: they are foundational, not emergent

xgi_casimir_hyperedge_size_4.detail: XGI hyperedge {L1,L2,L3,C2_so3} has size 4; Casimir is a 4-body relationship (3 generators + invariant)

xgi_partial_casimir_size_3_insufficient.detail: Partial Casimir hyperedge has size 3 (only 2 generators); full Casimir requires size 4 (all 3 generators)
